{"inserts":["INSERT INTO public.products (id, sku, name, category, price_cents) VALUES (OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE, 'SKU-EDGE-1', 'Edge Product A', $1, 100), (OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE, 'SKU-EDGE-2', 'Edge Product B', upper($1), 200), (OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE, 'SKU-EDGE-3', 'Edge Product C', 'unrelated-cat', 300)","INSERT INTO public.orders (id, user_id, status, total_cents, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE, DEFAULT, 'pending', 100, $3, $3), (OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE, DEFAULT, 'paid', 200, $3::timestamptz + interval '1 microsecond', $3)","INSERT INTO public.line_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM public.orders WHERE total_cents = 100 AND status = 'pending'), (SELECT id FROM public.products WHERE sku = 'SKU-EDGE-1'), $4, 100), ((SELECT id FROM public.orders WHERE total_cents = 200 AND status = 'paid'), (SELECT id FROM public.products WHERE sku = 'SKU-EDGE-1'), $4 - 1, 100), ((SELECT id FROM public.orders WHERE total_cents = 200 AND status = 'paid'), (SELECT id FROM public.products WHERE sku = 'SKU-EDGE-2'), $4, 200), ((SELECT id FROM public.orders WHERE total_cents = 200 AND status = 'paid'), (SELECT id FROM public.products WHERE sku = 'SKU-EDGE-3'), $4 + 1, 300)"]}
